Flat 2D vector illustration in the style of a modern animated science-explainer video: bold saturated colors, simple rounded geometric shapes, no outlines, smooth subtle gradients, soft glows, clean negative space, a hint of paper grain. Characters are cute round birds with stubby bodies, simple eyes and small triangular beaks, expressive but minimal. Every character is a BIRD (wings instead of arms and hands, wingtips instead of fingers, beaks instead of mouths, feathers instead of hair); there are no humans at all. Night palette: deep indigo and navy backgrounds, warm amber candle light, pale cream parchment, accents of coral red, teal and brass gold. Setting: a far-future gothic bureaucracy deep inside a planet-wide city, in the same flat style: windowless vaulted halls, long walls of small arched service-counter windows with brass grilles, rope queue barriers, towers of files, wax seals, candle stubs, brass pipes and hanging cables. Deadpan, understated mood. Widescreen 16:9 cinematic composition filling the whole frame, no black bars, no frame, no border. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numerals, no signs with writing, no captions, no name labels, no watermark; any writing on documents is drawn only as tiny illegible wavy scribble lines.
